title: Personal Loans Courtesy Waiver Amount: Calculation for the Latest Late Fee
content:
## Calculation

The fee waived is the latest late fee charged on the Personal Loans loan (on a tie of dates, the first one recorded). This courtesy amount is set only for the latest late fee charged on the loan while no fee payment has posted against it, and its unpaid part is then its amount less every earlier waiver line applied to it. The amount waived is the unpaid part times the courtesy share, which is 0.3, rounded to the cent. The amount waived is rounded to the cent once, at the end.

## Fees outside this calculation

A fee payment reaches a late fee only through the normal payment allocation, after the loan's accrued interest and every older unpaid fee are paid, so a late fee a fee payment has already reached is one the borrower is paying down; it stays under the standard courtesy clause of the fee waiver guidelines, which waives the whole part still unpaid, so that a fee the borrower has begun paying is cleared rather than left with a small remainder. An earlier late fee and a returned-payment fee also stay under those guidelines.

## Worked figures (hypothetical late fees)

| Latest late fee | Fee payment posted against it | Unpaid part | Amount waived |
|---|---|---|---|
| 30.00 | none | 30.00 | 30.00 times 0.3: 9.00 |
| 12.40 | none | 12.40 | 12.40 times 0.3: 3.72 |
| 30.00 | 10.00 | - | outside this calculation: the unpaid 20.00 under the fee waiver guidelines |
